# Choose the home

## Job

Choose how a game home for the tundra looks, where the animal lives near 70.81586800775494, 29.119861222924726. Code makes the
home from your choices; it keeps the land above the water and sets every number. You choose words and
colours only.

## Input

What the research found around it:

- dwarf birch (plant), animals eat it as browse
- crowberry (plant), animals eat it as berries
- wavy hair grass (plant), animals eat it as grass
- rocky tundra ground (ground)
- bog pools (water)
  - dwarf birch: green, red, yellow; tiny rounded serrated leaves, bushy spreading habit, male and female catkins

What the animal eats: crowberries (berries), dwarf birch (browse), bilberry (berries), wavy hair grass (grass).

The closest existing home, the starting point (its colours are a northern forest's; change them to this
habitat's):

{
 "description": "Flat open tundra with no tall trees and low bushes and grasses around many still pools.",
 "palette": {
  "ground_lush": "#7a8a44",
  "ground_dry": "#a3a06b",
  "ground_high": "#8a8f7a",
  "dirt": "#5a4a3a",
  "rock": "#8d8d8f",
  "sand": "#c8bf9e",
  "water_deep": "#27454e",
  "water_shallow": "#5f8a86",
  "ground_autumn": "#a3a06b",
  "snow": "#eef2f6",
  "heath_autumn": "#a3a06b"
 },
 "trees": {
  "density": 0.0,
  "mix": []
 },
 "lake_life": {
  "reeds": 0.15,
  "lilies": 0.0,
  "pondweed": 0.15
 }
}

Plants the game already has: bilberry, bracken, brain_coral, chanterelle, cottongrass, crowberry, fireweed, fly_agaric, goat_willow, heather, juniper, lily_of_the_valley, lingonberry, peat_moss, porcini, red_clover, red_stemmed_feathermoss, reindeer_lichen, sea_fan, spiny_wood_fern, staghorn_coral, wavy_hair_grass, white_clover, wild_raspberry, wood_anemone. Pick one only if it truly grows here; otherwise none. Tree shapes the
game draws: spruce (dark cone), pine (tall bare trunk, crown on top), birch (white trunk, small crown),
round (broadleaf tree), rowan (small tree), baobab, coconut_palm, italian_cy…<2954 chars>

description.description: one plain sentence a child understands: the land, the trees, the water

land.description: how the ground rises; mountains: high peaks with bare rock above the trees

water.description: the main water: river (runs through the land), lake (a big lake, the land around it), pools, sea (a coast: a deep bay and the sea all round), none

wetness.description: ponds, bogs and side streams besides the main water

water_name.description: a plain name for the main water, like 'Slow river'; no real place names

ice.description: none; frozen_in_winter (lakes or sea freeze in winter); glaciers (ice on the mountain tops); polar (ice over much of the land, icebergs, the water frozen most of the year)

caves.description: some: caves in the hills, only where the research finds caves or dens in rock

seabed.description: the floor of the deep water: sand for warm seas and reefs, mud otherwise

shape.description: the closest of the game's tree shapes

weight.description: share of the trees, all weights add to about 100

autumn.description: leaf colour in autumn if the leaves turn and fall; null in the tropics or for evergreens

model.description: a plant the game already has; only one that truly grows here

on.description: seabed: corals and sea grass, under the water

names.description: real foods of this kind here, plain names
